intro.heading: NIHAL
intro.description: I am an AI researcher and systems architect based in Kolkata, India. As the founder of KindSynapse AI and a core maintainer at Elixpo, I design compute-efficient neural models, distributed caching layers, and zero-GPU edge inference engines. I also conduct AI research with Pollinations.ai and undergraduate research at IEM Kolkata.

fancySection.subtitle: Systems & Theory
fancySection.content: My work focuses on removing computational bottlenecks in modern deep learning. At age 17, I built Azinet, a zero-dependency neural network library from scratch in pure Java, and qualified for the interview stage of PAIR FABRIC where I was interviewed by a joint Harvard-MIT researcher. Today, I direct KindSynapse AI, co-authored the 3-tier caching architecture behind OreoLook (arXiv:2609.05463), and won the Gold Medal at IEMPHYS-26 for ARGUS, a linear-complexity vision transformer for CERN particle tracking.
highlights: ARGUS in EPJ web of conference
fancySection.contactNote: I am open to conversations about AI systems research, extreme quantization kernels, linear-time attention mechanisms, and open-source infrastructure collaborations.
